title: Jadeanthium
description: This mod adds a new ore, new blocks, new tools and a new armor set. Pretty small mod.
body:
This is Jadeanthium.

This mod does not add much, however it was built with love (maybe).

I did not put in much effort in the making of this mod, so assume some bugs here and there.

All textures and ideas by xdec.
